title: halimium coulteri
intro: Halimium coulteri, commonly known as Coulter's rockrose, is a flowering plant species in the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Halimium coulteri include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which can help in pain relief, reducing inflammation, and protecting the body from oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Halimium coulteri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
